//: docker/mcpo-config.json — EXPANDED shared tool host for Open WebUI.
//2: mcpo bridges stdio MCP servers to OpenAPI so Open WebUI can call them. Each is served at its
//3: own subpath, e.g. http://mcpo:8000/serena , /fetch , /time . Browse all at :8000/docs.
//4: Add to Open WebUI: Admin -> Settings -> External Tools -> + -> Type OpenAPI, URL http://mcpo:8000/<name>.
//5: Note: mcpo runs in Docker. Servers that touch the filesystem/git only see what is mounted into the
//6: mcpo container. docker-compose.yml mounts REPOS_PATH (default ~/Documents/GitHub) at /repos so
//7: serena can reach your repos. Change serena --project below to any /repos/<name> you want in chat.

sequential-thinking.//: Gives chat models a scratchpad for multi-step reasoning.

context7.//: Up-to-date library docs, same as in OpenCode.

serena.//: Semantic code intel for chat. Default project /repos/app; all repos mounted under /repos.

fleet.//: ai-01 read-only fleet-inspection tools (fleet-mcp.service on the rig host). Same tools the ollmcp ops agent uses.
